propertyEvents.result: KRE-2219 for $2,336.88 is on the register as FA-107A, an improvement to the excavator; it is a repair. The invoice describes the work: "Repair after the hose failure of October 22. Returns the machine to normal operation." Its lines replace a failed hydraulic hose and worn bucket teeth. Under FA-3 a repair that restores an asset after a breakdown is expensed; nothing here extends the excavator's life or adds capacity. The bill is already in 6300 Repairs & Maintenance (AP-10423), which is right. Take FA-107A off the register and drop draft line 5 from JE-2610-FA1; no entry is needed.

propertyEvents.result: FA-105 was sold on October 28 for $12,000.00; the ledger still carries it, and no loss was recorded. The bill of sale and the register agree: Tidewater Used Modulars bought the site office trailer, Phase 4 for $12,000.00. GL 1510 still holds its $36,000.00 cost, 1590 its depreciation, and nothing was booked to 7200. Under FA-4 it is depreciated through October, so accumulated depreciation at sale is $16,500.00 ($16,200.00 to September 30 plus $300.00 for October, already in RJ-03) and book value is $19,500.00. Against the $12,000.00 price that is a $7,500.00 loss. AJ-02 removes the cost and depreciation, records the proceeds as a receivable (payment was due within 10 days of pickup, after October 31) and books the loss under FA-5.

propertyEvents.result: October depreciation on the corrected register is $4,854.54; the close's entries carry $4,532.15. Every asset recomputes straight-line from its cost and life, a full month in October for those placed in service in October and for the trailer sold in October (FA-4). The register's own October column says $5,421.08, because it still depreciates the two items struck above. The close staged RJ-03 for $3,716.67 and proposed AJ-02 for $815.48 on the excavator at its booked cost. The rest, $322.39, is October's depreciation on the full cost AJ-01 capitalizes. AJ-03 books it; if AJ-01 is not approved, this entry falls away with it.

Roll Forward and Tie to the Ledger

Cost rolls from $219,600.00 to $322,389.56: $138,789.56 of additions and $36,000.00 sold. Accumulated depreciation rolls from $101,420.00 to $89,774.54. Each account equals the ledger after the proposed entries and the corrected register, to the cent (FA-6). Net book value is $232,615.02.
Add up the open items
Fixed assets roll forward to $322,389.56 of cost and $232,615.02 of book value, tied to the ledger. 3 entries proposed for $63,811.95, 5 exceptions for a person. Nothing was posted.

task.title: HANGS Construction · October 2026 Fixed Asset Roll-Forward
task.description: Roll HANGS Construction's fixed assets forward through October 2026: the updated fixed asset register, the October AP lines behind each addition, the staff accountant's draft capitalization entry, a repair invoice, a bill of sale, the close's depreciation entries and the fixed asset policy. Tests every addition, accounts for the asset sold, recomputes depreciation by method and class, and ties cost and accumulated depreciation to GL 1500, 1510, 1520 and 1590 to the cent. Proposes entries for a person. Never posts.

light.reason: Waiting for review: draft package ready, open items remain

task.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Fixed Asset Workpapers with evidence tabs, and an unsigned Fixed Asset Memo with every proposed entry
